text:
elena: Quick sync — last night's PD (PD12345) got captured by the pm-canvas bot but the action items didn't flow into the action-tracker dashboard. Noticed two missing owners and one missing priority tag. Anyone else seeing this?

devin: I saw that. The canvas was created, timeline looks fine, but the mapping step to action-tracker returned 422 for two items.

marcus: @devin can you paste the canvas ID? I can check the mapping logs.

pm-canvas-bot: Canvas created: canvas://c-2026-03-14-1714998000 (incident PD12345). 7 cards detected, 5 labelled "action", 2 labelled "followup". Mapping attempt: 5 succeeded, 2 failed (422 invalid payload).

devin: canvas id: c-2026-03-14-1714998000. Failed items look like they had leading whitespace in "owner" field from transcription. Weird.

elena: Ah — we saw OCR/truncation artifacts in a couple spots. We should validate and normalize owner strings before mapping. Also scheduling: need to lock postmortem meeting within 48h. Who can own scheduling?

marcus: I can own scheduling. I'll use the fast template. Also will manually add missing owners for now.

devin: For the longer-term fix, propose we add a normalization step in pm-canvas service: trim(), lowercase, and cross-check against SSO directory. If ambiguous, open a 'needs-assignment' card rather than failing mapping.

elena: +1. That would avoid 422s. Also we should add an explicit "priority" mapping (sev -> priority tag) because the bot currently relies on free-text.

marcus: Agreed. Action list from this thread: 1) marucs schedule pm within 48h and attach canvas + timeline to the calendar invite. 2) devin add normalization + fallback to 'needs-assignment' in pm-canvas. 3) elena open a quick dashboard alert for mapping failures so oncall sees it in realtime. 4) add unit tests for owner normalization.

devin: I'll open the PR for normalization. Draft branch: github.com/redwood/pm-canvas/compare/fix/owner-normalize. Will include tests and a regression test with the PD12345 payload. ETA EOD tomorrow.

pm-canvas-bot: Suggested command to finalize canvas and post to postmortem draft: 
```
/pm-canvas finalize --canvas=c-2026-03-14-1714998000 --incident=PD12345 --link=calendar://pm-PD12345 --assign=marcus
```
elena: Nice. Marcus — once you schedule can you run that finalize command so the draft shows up in the postmortem doc? Also add the "customer-impact" section manually — bot's classifier missed a partial outage note in the logs.

marcus: Will do. Scheduling now. Blocking note: need the action-tracker API key to auto-post items. Who has that?

sre-bot: Reminder: action-tracker token is stored in Vault at secret/data/action-tracker/prod. Access requires "sre" or "eng-oncall" group membership.

elena: I can grant temporary access for the mapping task. Devin ping me with the github PR and I will annotate the deploy checklist.

devin: pinged you with link. Also adding a small telemetry event on mapping failures so we can graph failure rate.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: staging build for devin/fix-owner-normalize passed integration tests. Manual review required for vault access changes.

marcus: Calendar invite sent for "PD12345 postmortem" — scheduled tomorrow 09:30 UTC. I've attached the canvas link and timeline. I'll run the finalize command after elena grants the token.

elena: Grant done for the branch's deploy service account, expires in 24h. Marcus you should be able to finalize now.

marcus: Running finalize...

pm-canvas-bot: Finalize OK. Postmortem draft created: https://pm.redwood.internal/postmortem/PD12345-draft. 5 action items pushed to action-tracker, 2 items flagged 'needs-assignment' (owner normalized failed).

devin: Thanks. I'll triage the two flagged items in the PR before merging normalization. Also opening a tiny RFC to add a validation step to postmortem templates so bots can optionally require certain fields (owner, priority, customer-impact).

elena: Love that. Can we add a quick dashboard row in Console to show 'pm-canvas mapping failures' and link to the new RFC? Minor UX: make the dashboard row show last failure summary and the canvas link.

marcus: Created dashboard card and pinned to #eng-oncall -> link posted in invite.

elena: Ok, next steps recap (I'll paste into the calendar notes):
- marucs: run finalize (done) and host the postmortem tomorrow.
- devin: PR for normalization + tests (ETA: EOD tomorrow).
- elena: short-lived token grant (done) + add dashboard alert (in progress).
- ops: add automation note to deploy checklist for vault access.

marcus: I'll also add a one-line 'how we finalize with bot' section to the postmortem template so oncall knows steps.

devin: FYI I'll include a small synthetic test (fixture) that simulates leading/trailing whitespace and a bogus owner to ensure it goes to 'needs-assignment'.

elena: Thanks all. If no objections I'll mark this thread as actioned and close out. :thumbsup:

marcus: :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Logged actions: action-8912 (schedule pm, owner marucs), action-8913 (normalize owner strings, owner devin), action-8914 (dashboard alert, owner elena), action-8915 (deploy checklist update, owner ops).

elena: Great. Closing thread — will check postmortem tomorrow after meeting and follow up if there are outstanding actions.
